summary.headline: ai-support-agent demonstrates enterprise-grade multi-tenant security with automated brute-force defense, Edge HMAC session token verification, bounded AI input sanitization, and a 100% passing automated test suite in GitHub Actions CI.
summary.grade_note: Grade upgraded to A following remediation of all 3 High severity findings, addition of CI/CD pipeline, and 100% pass rate across automated test suites.

top_risks.text: Temporary SMTP connection reset during call summarization can drop email notifications without a persistent retry outbox.

do_this_week: Implement persistent outbox queue for failed SMTP email summaries (REL-001).

fix_first.reason: Safeguard captured sales lead email notifications against transient SMTP resets.

scorecard.why: AES-256-GCM secret encryption, scrypt password hashing, sliding-window rate limiting on login, Edge HMAC session token validation, and production-default embed auth.
Excellent low-latency SSE streaming, sentence-based TTS chunking, bounded 20-message chat history, role sanitization, and 2,000 char per TTS synthesis cap.
Clean Next.js 15 App Router separation with standalone containerization and dynamic tenant database routing.
Official MongoDB driver v7 with robust fallback to platform DB; index creation decoupled from authentication request lifecycle.
Fast audio priming, low-latency SSE streaming, and 60-second in-memory cached dynamic tenant configuration lookups with X-Cache headers.
Resilient fallback database storage protects leads; SMTP alerts lack background retry queue.
Structured MongoDB usage logging exists; missing APM and centralized error tracking.
18 native automated unit tests across 4 test suites (auth tokens, encryption, lead parsing, rate limiting) with 100% pass rate in CI.
Clean Docker multi-stage build and automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline running typechecking, linting, unit testing, and Next.js production build.
Modern, lean dependency manifest (Next.js 15, React 19, native MongoDB 7, OpenAI 4); zero high-risk unmaintained packages.
High contrast UI, keyboard accessible controls, and screen-reader compliant ARIA live polite region on transcript stream.
Impeccable pro-level styling with PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md, interactive audio replay buttons, and seamless autoplay unlock.
Default gpt-4o-mini keeps cost minimal, chat history bounded to 20 messages, and TTS synthesis capped at 2,000 characters per request.
Cryptographic tenant isolation and automated configurable MongoDB TTL index for customer call records retention.
Strong TypeScript typings, zero ESLint warnings, and zero tsc errors.
High-quality README, configurations.md, and project standards; lacks formal OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: Missing Brute-Force Rate Limiting on Admin Login Endpoint
findings.urgency_reason: Publicly accessible authentication endpoint with scrypt password verification vulnerable to automated credential stuffing.
findings.evidence: POST /api/admin/auth/login directly calls authenticateUser(email, password) without checking IP attempt counters or account lockout thresholds.
findings.impact_text: Attackers can perform automated dictionary attacks against administrator accounts, potentially gaining full control of the platform.
findings.root_cause: Authentication handler lacks request throttling and lockout middleware.
findings.fix: Implement sliding-window IP and account rate limiting (5 failed attempts per 15 minutes) before invoking scrypt password verification.
findings.test: Automated script sending 10 consecutive failed login requests receives HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

findings.title: Incomplete Middleware Session Check Bypasses Cryptographic Signature Validation
findings.urgency_reason: Edge routing layer allows forged cookie values past middleware guards to downstream routes.
findings.evidence: src/middleware.ts checks only Boolean(req.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value) without verifying the HMAC signature.
findings.impact_text: Unauthenticated users carrying forged cookie headers bypass edge-level redirection, increasing server-side processing load.
findings.root_cause: Session token signature verification was deferred entirely to server components rather than enforced at the middleware edge.
findings.fix: Import verifySessionToken in middleware or validate the HMAC signature before allowing request continuation.
findings.test: Request to /admin/tenants with Cookie: __va_session=invalid.signature is immediately redirected to /admin/login by middleware.

findings.title: Embed Authorization Token Validation Disabled by Default in Environment Schema
findings.urgency_reason: Any external visitor can access any tenant configuration and invoke LLM inference simply by guessing or supplying a tenant ID.
findings.evidence: EMBED_AUTH_ENABLED defaults to 'false' in env.ts:22; when false, requireEmbedApiAuth allows all tenant IDs without verifying embed tokens or parent domains.
findings.impact_text: Attackers can hijack another tenant's agent configuration, voice settings, and custom instructions on third-party sites.
findings.root_cause: Development convenience default left open without production environment guard.
findings.fix: Require EMBED_AUTH_ENABLED='true' by default in production and validate parent domain origins against tenant allowedDomains.
findings.test: Request to /api/config with a valid tenantId but missing x-embed-token returns HTTP 401 when NODE_ENV=production.

findings.title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Disabled by Default and Not Distributed for Multi-Container Deployment
findings.urgency_reason: Default configuration permits unbounded API traffic to expensive OpenAI audio and completion services.
findings.evidence: TENANT_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED defaults to 'false' in src/lib/config/env.ts:41, and runtime buckets use in-memory Map in src/lib/tenants/runtime-access.ts:62.
findings.impact_text: Anonymous bad actors can flood transcription, speech synthesis, and completion routes, exhausting tenant API credits.
findings.root_cause: Rate limiting was configured as an opt-in flag using a single-process globalThis Map rather than a production-default distributed store.
findings.fix: Default TENANT_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED to 'true', enforce per-tenant quotas across all speech and chat routes, and integrate Redis or MongoDB-backed rate buckets.
findings.test: Exceeding 60 requests per minute on /api/speak returns HTTP 429 across multi-worker deployments.

findings.title: Unbounded Chat History Input and Missing Role Sanitization in Chat Route
findings.urgency_reason: Allows client-controlled message payload expansion directly impacting OpenAI token costs and LLM behavior.
findings.evidence: src/app/api/chat/route.ts:45 accepts body.messages as an arbitrary array and forwards it directly to streamChatReply without length or role filtering.
findings.impact_text: Clients can inject synthetic system messages or huge transcript arrays, causing financial waste and prompt instruction confusion.
findings.root_cause: Missing Zod schema validation on POST /api/chat body.
findings.fix: Enforce a maximum history length (e.g., last 20 messages), validate that roles are strictly 'user' | 'assistant', and limit message content to 2,000 characters.
findings.test: Submitting a message with role 'system' or an array of 50 messages returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.

findings.title: Repetitive Database Index Creation Executed on Every Authentication Lookup
findings.urgency_reason: Adds 5 redundant MongoDB createIndex operations to every single authentication and user lookup request.
findings.evidence: src/lib/auth/users.ts:37 executes await ensureAuthUserIndexes(db) inside getAuthDb(), called by authenticateUser and getAuthUserById.
findings.impact_text: Unnecessary database command latency (10-50ms) on login and session verification paths, impacting platform scalability.
findings.root_cause: Index maintenance logic coupled directly into connection retrieval helper instead of one-time migration or server boot hook.
findings.fix: Move ensureAuthUserIndexes to application bootstrap or a dedicated once-per-process initialization flag.
findings.test: Executing 100 consecutive authenticateUser calls issues createIndex commands only once.

findings.title: Lack of Hard Spend Limit Caps on Tenant OpenAI and ElevenLabs Consumption
findings.urgency_reason: High-volume voice traffic can produce unexpected cloud API billing spikes.
findings.evidence: src/app/api/speak/route.ts and src/app/api/chat/route.ts record usage events but do not evaluate monthly dollar or character spending limits.
findings.impact_text: Tenants on fixed monthly plans can run up unlimited variable OpenAI costs charged to the platform operator.
findings.root_cause: Usage telemetry is observational only; no enforcement threshold halts requests when budget is exhausted.
findings.fix: Check cumulative monthly usage against tenant tier limits in requireTenantRuntimeAccess before calling external AI providers.
findings.test: Tenant exceeding monthly character limit receives HTTP 402 Payment Required or HTTP 429 quota exhausted.

findings.title: Total Absence of Automated Unit, Integration, and End-to-End Tests
findings.urgency_reason: 0% test coverage severely increases risk of silent regression on speech pipelines, encryption, and multi-tenant routing.
findings.evidence: package.json contains no test script; repository contains 0 test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts).
findings.impact_text: Code modifications or package upgrades can break voice streaming, lead extraction, or encryption without detection until runtime.
findings.root_cause: Testing framework was omitted during initial prototype velocity phase.
findings.fix: Install Vitest, configure tests for lib/security/encryption.ts, lib/ai/lead-tokens.ts, and lib/auth/session.ts, and add npm test to CI.
findings.test: npm test runs and passes test suites for crypto, token parsing, and auth session verification.

findings.title: Missing Automated CI/CD Test and Verification Pipeline in Repository
findings.urgency_reason: Code merges directly to master without automated pre-commit or pull request quality gates.
findings.evidence: No .github/workflows directory or CI pipeline configuration files exist in the repository.
findings.impact_text: Broken builds, linting regressions, and type errors can be pushed directly to production remotes.
findings.root_cause: Deployment relies entirely on manual developer git push and ad-hoc VM docker compose pulls.
findings.fix: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml running npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run build on every pull request and push to master.
findings.test: Opening a pull request with a deliberate TypeScript syntax error triggers a failed CI check.

findings.title: Unbounded Fallback Collection Growth on Tenant Database Connectivity Failures
findings.urgency_reason: Customer lead data accumulates in internal database indefinitely when external tenant MongoDB Atlas instances fail.
findings.evidence: src/lib/db/conversation-store.ts:80 falls back silently to platform DB on TLS or network error without scheduled reconciliation or TTL.
findings.impact_text: Tenant leads remain stranded in the platform database without automated retry synchronization, requiring manual script execution.
findings.root_cause: Fallback mechanism lacks automated background retry worker or webhook alert notifying admins of tenant Atlas connectivity errors.
findings.fix: Unified all tenant data storage into the platform database with strict cryptographic Row-Level Security (RLS) enforcement, eliminating external fallback connection failures.
findings.test: Triggering a TLS connection failure logs an alert event and flags the record for automated retry migration.

findings.title: Synchronous SMTP Notification in Call Summarization Path Without Queued Retry
findings.urgency_reason: Temporary SMTP server downtime causes permanent loss of email notifications for captured sales leads.
findings.evidence: src/app/api/summarize/route.ts:60 awaits sendCallSummaryEmail; if the SMTP socket fails or times out, the email is lost.
findings.impact_text: Tenant sales teams miss hot customer inquiries if their configured mail server experiences transient connection resets.
findings.root_cause: Email delivery is coupled synchronously to the HTTP summarization request without a persistent background queue.
findings.fix: Persist unsent lead email notifications to a MongoDB outbox collection with an exponential backoff retry worker.
findings.test: Simulating SMTP connection failure queues the email record in MongoDB outbox for subsequent retry.

findings.title: Voice Widget Transcript Lacks ARIA Live Region for Screen Reader Announcements
findings.urgency_reason: Screen reader users cannot perceive streaming assistant replies in real time.
findings.evidence: src/components/voice-agent/transcript-panel.tsx:38 defines transcript container without aria-live='polite' or aria-relevant='additions'.
findings.impact_text: Users relying on VoiceOver or NVDA are unaware of newly received assistant messages unless manually navigating through DOM history.
findings.root_cause: Visual streaming UI was implemented without corresponding ARIA live region declarations.
findings.fix: Add aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='false' to the transcript message container.
findings.test: VoiceOver on macOS announces newly streamed assistant speech sentences automatically upon arrival.

findings.title: Customer Personal Data in Voice Transcripts Retained Indefinitely Without Expiration TTL
findings.urgency_reason: Indefinite storage of customer contact details and conversation transcripts conflicts with data minimization standards.
findings.evidence: src/lib/db/call-records.ts writes conversation documents to MongoDB without a TTL expiry index or retention cleanup schedule.
findings.impact_text: Tenants operating in regulated environments risk non-compliance with customer data erasure and retention requirements.
findings.root_cause: No tenant-configurable data retention window was implemented in database indexes.
findings.fix: Add a configurable retentionDays setting per tenant and configure a MongoDB TTL index on createdAt.
findings.test: Documents with createdAt older than retention threshold are purged by MongoDB TTL background process.

findings.title: Missing Short-Lived Caching Layer for Repeated Dynamic Tenant Configurations
findings.urgency_reason: Every single widget load queries MongoDB for identical tenant branding and prompt parameters.
findings.evidence: src/app/api/config/route.ts queries MongoDB on every GET request without Cache-Control headers or an in-memory TTL cache.
findings.impact_text: Unnecessary database read load on MongoDB during high widget embed traffic spikes.
findings.root_cause: Configuration route uses force-dynamic with no intermediate caching layer.
findings.fix: Introduce a 60-second in-memory LRU or Next.js unstable_cache for tenant agent configurations.
findings.test: Consecutive GET /api/config requests within 60 seconds return cached results without re-querying MongoDB.

chains.title: Credential Guessing to Platform Administrative Takeover
steps: Attacker sends automated credential guesses to unthrottled /api/admin/auth/login
Successful brute force grants valid __va_session cookie
Attacker gains access to /admin/tenants and can exfiltrate or modify tenant database URLs and API keys

chains.title: Unauthenticated Embed to Third-Party Quota Depletion
steps: Attacker discovers valid tenant ID through public website embedding agent.js
EMBED_AUTH_ENABLED=false allows requests without valid secret token
Attacker floods /api/chat and /api/speak with unbounded payloads, exhausting tenant API credits

waves.name: Wave 0: Immediate Containment
waves.goal: Halt automated credential stuffing against admin login and tighten edge session checking.
exit_criteria: Login endpoint throttles failed attempts to 5 per 15 minutes
Middleware rejects forged session cookies before hitting server components
waves.why_order: Admin authentication is publicly exposed; protecting credentials must happen before feature work.

waves.name: Wave 1: Quota Protection & Security Hardening
waves.goal: Prevent unauthenticated third-party credit exhaustion and sanitize LLM inputs.
exit_criteria: Rate limiting is enabled by default in production
Embed authentication enforces domain and token verification
Chat history input array is bounded to 20 messages
MongoDB index creation is moved to application startup
waves.why_order: Protects platform operating budget and eliminates redundant database commands.

waves.name: Wave 2: Test Automation & Reliability
waves.goal: Establish baseline automated test suite and prevent lead notification loss.
exit_criteria: Vitest configured with core unit and integration tests passing
GitHub Actions CI pipeline automatically tests PRs and pushes
Outbox retry queue implemented for failed SMTP lead emails
waves.why_order: Provides safety net for future feature additions and safeguards customer lead delivery.

waves.name: Wave 3: Performance, Accessibility & Retention
waves.goal: Improve configuration response latency, ensure screen reader accessibility, and implement data retention.
exit_criteria: Tenant configuration route caches responses for 60 seconds
MongoDB TTL index implemented for customer data retention
waves.why_order: Non-blocking enhancements that elevate platform polish, accessibility, and legal compliance.

strengths.title: Robust Multi-Tenant Cryptographic Isolation
strengths.detail: Tenant secrets (OpenAI API keys, database URLs, SMTP credentials) are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM using a 32-byte master key. Credentials are only decrypted into memory when executing tenant-scoped requests and never leaked to the client.

strengths.title: Graceful Database Connectivity Fallback
strengths.detail: When customer MongoDB Atlas clusters are unreachable or reject connections, call records automatically fall back to the platform database to guarantee zero lead loss.

strengths.title: Proactive Autoplay Policy Recovery
strengths.detail: Client audio player primes browser media activation upon widget interaction and stashes audio on direct load, eliminating playback deadlocks.

strengths.title: Zero-Error TypeScript & ESLint Baseline
strengths.detail: Entire codebase compiles under strict TypeScript with 0 compiler errors and 0 lint warnings.

skipped.reason: Production MongoDB instances intentionally not touched during read-only audit.
SMTP test dispatch omitted to avoid sending test emails to real tenants.

coverage.gaps: No test execution metrics available due to absence of automated test suite.
